annotations.title: Status of an enrolled agent card appraisal charge

description: RAIL: AGENT CARD. Status and collection for buy_appraisal_agent_card charges only, keyed by the operationId you paid under. Read one card-agent-1 charge and collect the appraisal when it is ready. Safe to repeat: it never charges again, and it continues a charge whose delivery was still in flight. Not for the other rails: a human-card checkout order is read with appraisal_order_status (orderId + orderToken); a prepaid-balance purchase is read with appraisal_purchase_status (operationId).
name: appraisal_card_order_status
title: Status of an enrolled agent card appraisal charge
